qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Irreplaceable Scottish electricity transmission and distribution network monopolies under Ofgem RIIO regulation, combined with prime offshore wind farms backed by long-term UK government Contracts for Difference (CfDs). Inflation indexing protects revenues, but returns are constrained by regulatory allowed returns and merchant commodity power exposure.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (gate_6 = N, REJECT). Essential UK regulated transmission/distribution networks and leading offshore wind developer, but structurally fails the fortress balance sheet and self-funded cash conversion standards. FY2025 capex of £4.44B vastly exceeds operating cash flow (£3.44B), resulting in negative free cash flow after capex (-£1.01B). Net debt of £7.00B is 5.8x net income (£1.21B), requiring ongoing debt financing and minority asset stake sales to maintain liquidity.
qualitative.evidence: Reported 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 8.14%, constrained by Ofgem regulatory caps on networks and volatile wholesale power prices. FY2025 capex of £4.44B vs OCF of £3.44B generates a cash deficit of -£1.01B. Net debt of £7.00B represents 5.8x net income (£1.21B), while gross debt of £8.54B is 7.1x NI, both exceeding the 4.0x ceiling. Continuous dependence on capital markets and minority network stake sales (e.g. selling 25% of SSEN Transmission) violates Gate 6 balance sheet independence.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
